plan.summary: PKT-1 AI Upgrade: GR-2.2 Agent Assist v2 (Knowledge-powered reply generation, source references, tone presets, follow-up questions, conversation summary) + GR-2.3 Multi-lang (Claude inline language detection, multi-lang prompts, Knowledge chunk lang filter, Outbound full multi-lang with template/recipient/auto-detect). 4 services affected: AgentAI (7105), Knowledge (7104), Outbound (7107), Backend (5000).
plan.q_intent: PKT-1: AI Upgrade (GR-2.2 + GR-2.3) basla. Scope: GR-2.2 Agent Assist v2: Reply generation Knowledge'dan beslenecek, kaynak referansi, tone presets, multi-turn context. GR-2.3 Multi-lang: Language detection, multi-lang response, Knowledge multi-lang, Outbound dil secimi. Etkilenen servisler: AgentAI (7105), Knowledge (7104), Outbound (7107), Backend (5000).
plan.interview_notes: 1) Service pattern: AgentAI -> Knowledge DIRECT service-to-service call (localhost:7104, no Backend proxy hop). 2) Source references: Agent-facing only (sources[] in response, not in customer reply text). 3) Tone presets: Per-tenant in tenant_registry.settings_json (default_tone field), feedback learning operates ON TOP of tone. 4) Language detection: Claude inline (detect + reply in same language, zero extra cost). Outbound uses lightweight regex (Turkish char detection). 5) Multi-turn context: BOTH follow-up question generation AND conversation summary for long histories. 6) Knowledge fallback: Graceful degradation (Knowledge down = old behavior, knowledge_available:false flag). 7) Outbound lang: Full implementation (template lang column + recipient lang preference + auto-detect from conversation).

verification_questions.question: Does AgentAI gracefully degrade when Knowledge service is unavailable (timeout/connection refused), returning a valid suggestion without Knowledge context and setting knowledge_available=false?
Are Knowledge search results correctly injected into Claude's system prompt with source metadata, and does the response include a sources[] array with sourceType, title, pageNumber for each result?
Does the conversation summary kick in only when history exceeds a configurable threshold (e.g. 15+ messages), and does it correctly compress older messages while preserving recent ones verbatim?
Is Claude instructed to detect the customer's language AND respond in that language, with detected_language reliably extracted from the structured JSON response?
Does the Outbound service correctly select templates by language, and when no template matches the requested language, does it fall back to the tenant's default language template with a warning?
Are all new DB columns added via migration SQL files (not altering existing schema files), and do the migrations include proper indexes, defaults, and GRANT statements?

Does the tone preset from tenant_registry.settings_json correctly influence the Claude system prompt, and does per-agent feedback learning operate as an additive layer on top of the tone (not replaced by it)?
verification_questions.codex_answer: BY DESIGN: Tone originates from Main App (reads tenant_registry.settings_json.default_tone) -> sent in request body as 'tone' field -> Backend proxies raw JSON (passthrough, no transformation) -> AgentAI reads request.Tone. This is correct per interview note #3: tone is per-tenant, set in settings_json. AgentAI cannot directly query tenant_registry (service isolation). Feedback learning (agentProfile) is appended AFTER tone in system prompt (ReplyGenerator.cs:164+187), confirming additive behavior.
verification_questions.codex_result: EXPECTED_UNKNOWN: tenant_registry.settings_json source is in Main App (separate system, outside InvektoServices repo). Within this repo: (1) tone field accepted via DTO (SuggestReplyRequest.Tone), (2) tone injected into Claude system prompt (ReplyGenerator.cs:164-174), (3) agentProfile appended AFTER tone (ReplyGenerator.cs:187-192) confirming additive. The Main App -> Backend -> AgentAI chain is verified by Backend raw JSON passthrough (AgentAIClient.ProxySuggestAsync). Full end-to-end verification requires Main App integration test.

non_goals: Dashboard UI for tone/language settings (Main App handles tenant settings)
ChatAnalysis language detection endpoint (Claude inline is sufficient)
Knowledge embedding cache (LRU) or SSE progress
Multi-lang prompt templates beyond TR/EN (future: AR, DE, RU)
Outbound WhatsApp API integration (already exists via Main App callback)
intentional_exclusions: Source references in customer-facing reply text (agent-only per Q decision)
Per-agent tone override (per-tenant only, per Q decision)
Separate language detection endpoint (Claude inline per Q decision)
Backend proxy for AgentAI->Knowledge (direct call per Q decision)

user_facing_errors: INV-AA-007: Knowledge service unavailable (graceful: reply still generated)
INV-AA-008: Language detection failed (graceful: defaults to 'tr')
INV-AA-009: Conversation summary failed (graceful: uses raw truncated history)
INV-OB-011: Template language not available (graceful: falls back to default language)
INV-OB-012: No template found for language (error: no valid template)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All fallback paths log warnings via SystemWarn. Knowledge unavailable = knowledge_available:false flag in response. Language detection failure = defaults to 'tr' with warning. No silent return null paths.
